boundaries.description: Increase Crit Rate by 15% and the damage of the Enhanced Technique, Flash of Nihility, by 20%.
boundaries.name: Las Noches Executor

boundaries.description: Increase the damage boost effect of Form of Void by an extra 80%.
boundaries.name: The Meaning of Void

boundaries.description: Increases all Special Attack DMG by 50% and Technique DMG by 125%.
boundaries.name: A Worthy Opponent

corePassives.description: Techniques, or Counterattacks, he launches 4 different types of Cero at enemies: Cero Combo - Basic attack, Cero Combo - Special Attack, Cero Combo - Technique, and Cero Combo - Counter. Each Cero activates its corresponding Cero Mark. When all 4 Cero Marks are activated, the technique is enhanced. After every 2 releases of Cero Combo - Special Attack, Ulquiorra can actively release 1 counterattack, which deals 50% less damage. If Ulquiorra's basic attacks, Unsheathed and Blade Pursuit, or the technique, Heavy Pressure, are used at the right moment, they can block enemy attacks.
corePassives.name: Cero Mark

corePassives.description: For each Cero Mark Ulquiorra consumes, his ATK is increased by 3.5% for 25 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.
corePassives.name: Nihility

corePassives.description: Whenever Ulquiorra releases a Cero, increases the next Ultimate DMG by 10%, stacking up to 8 times, with an extra 20% increase at full stacks.
corePassives.name: Void

corePassives.description: Increases the Spiritual Pressure gained by Ulquiorra through his basic attack, Blade Pursuit, by 100%. When an attack is blocked by his core passive, Cero Mark, he gains an extra 15 Spiritual Pressure.
corePassives.name: Obliteration

name: Ulquiorra Shifar (SR+)
note: This Base-form Ulquiorra, is/was a free SR+ Spirit DPS unit.

skills.description: Ulquiorra performs a 5-hit combo against enemies in front, dealing a total damage equal to (lvl 9: 616%) of ATK and building his Spiritual Pressure. The 5th basic attack releases Cero Combo - Basic Attack. Using Sonido during basic attacks will not interrupt the current basic attack sequence. After releasing a technique, special attack, or counter, tap Basic Attack to perform Blade Pursuit. Ulquiorra draws his blade, quickly closes in, and slashes enemies in front, dealing damage equal to (lvl 9: 252%) of ATK. On hit, he gains a large amount of Spiritual Pressure. After releasing this skill, he can directly chain into the 3rd basic attack. This skill can trigger a counter and can successfully counter enemies when released at the right moment. While in Form of Void, repeatedly tap or tap and hold Basic Attack to release Cero Combo - Basic Attack, Cero Combo - Counter, Cero Combo - Technique, and the enhanced Cero Combo - Special Attack in sequence. The enhanced Cero Combo - Special Attack deals damage equal to (lvl 9: 320%) of ATK and is considered a Special Attack. At Max Spiritual Pressure, tap and hold Basic Attack. Ulquiorra will dash forward and perform a melee attack. Tap Basic Attack again or tap and hold it to continue the follow-up attack. On the final hit, he leaps into the air and releases Cero Combo - Special Attack, dealing a total damage equal to (lvl 9: 400%) of ATK. For a short time after releasing this skill, tap Basic Attack to release Blade Pursuit.
skills.name: Unsheated

skills.description: Ulquiorra dashes to the enemy's side, performs a series of thrusts, and releases Core Combo - Technique, dealing a total damage equal to (lvl 9: 560%) of ATK and building his Spiritual Pressure. Ulquiorra can consume all Cero Marks and releases a devastating Cero, dealing damage equal to (lvl 9: 924%) of ATK to enemies.
skills.name: Heavy Pressure

skills.description: Ulquiorra dashes in front of the enemy and raises his hand to pierce through their body, dealing damage equal to (lvl 9: 1920%) of ATK and entering Form of Void for 4.5 seconds to increase his damage dealt by 20%. During this state, repeatedly tap or tap and hold Basic Attack to release Cero Barrage, launching different types of Cero at the enemy in sequence.
skills.name: Dead End

skills.description: Upon blocking the enemy's attack, Ulquiorra releases Cero Combo - Counter to counterattack, dealing damage equal to (lvl 9: 680%) of ATK.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Sonido to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Ulquiorra gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Sonido
